verdict.rationale: monday.com's developer docs say each agent gets its own identity, admins can scope each agent's board access and audit its actions, and apps can request granular scopes like `boards:read` with keys kept in managed secret storage. Together these cover least-privilege, agent-specific access. All of this comes from marketing-level developer-site copy. Missing for 10: detailed docs on minting per-agent API tokens or keys with specific scopes, a documented scope catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
